# Africa Oracle Extraction Agent

> Resilient mobile-money price oracle for African currencies. Aggregates real-time FX feeds from M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Orange Money, MTN MoMo across ~30 countries into a quorum-protected, outlier-filtered median rate. Phase 0 of the AFRI Jetton stablecoin on TON (TIP-74).

The project exposes a Python CLI (`oracle_agent.py`), an HTTP API (`api/app.py`), Go and POSIX-shell ports (`oracle_agent.go`, `oracle_agent.sh`), and a 5-channel SDK distribution (Python, TypeScript, browser extension MV3, PWA, VSCode). It is multi-arch (amd64 + arm64), self-hostable via Docker, and free-tier viable on Fly.io.

Every claim on every surface maps to code or docs in this repository. See `FACTS.md`.

## API

- [Live dashboard](https://africa-oracle.fly.dev/) with converter and live rate grid
- [GET /health](https://africa-oracle.fly.dev/health): liveness + version
- [GET /providers](https://africa-oracle.fly.dev/providers): provider × country × currency map
- [GET /rate/{from}/{to}](https://africa-oracle.fly.dev/rate/KES/NGN): simple GET exchange rate
- [GET /openapi.json](https://africa-oracle.fly.dev/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 schema
- POST /convert `{from, to, amount, side}`: cross-currency conversion
- POST /feeds/robust `{min_providers, tukey_k}`: quorum + Tukey-fence outlier filter
- GET /feeds/stream?interval=N: Server-Sent Events live feed
- GET /widget.js: one-line embeddable rate widget

- [oracle_agent.py](oracle_agent.py): canonical Python implementation

- [oracle_agent.go](oracle_agent.go): Go port
- [oracle_agent.sh](oracle_agent.sh): POSIX shell port
- [afri-token.fc](afri-token.fc): TON Jetton smart contract (TIP-74)
